Perfect for the holiday table or gifting to your most treasured tea lover.
The Warming Joy Tea Chest Duo Gift Bundle is a $176 value and includes:

Two Warming Joy Tea Chests of 40 assorted pyramid tea infusers, two of each blend

Each pyramid infuser steeps 8-12 ounces of tea
Each box measures 8.4L x 7.9D x 3.4H"

All teas in this bundle are Kosher Certified
